properties.srs_summary:
Document: Contacts 1.0 - Software Requirements Specification (Phone Application)

Functional requirements summary:
- Add New Contact (3.2.1.1.1): Provide interface to enter name, phone number, email, optional fields (company, job title, notes). Save to local database immediately upon user confirmation.
- Contact Field Validation (3.2.1.1.2): Validate before saving: name non-empty, ≤100 chars; phone number supports international (+country code, e.g., +1-555-0123) or national (e.g., 555-0123) format; email (if provided) must be standard format. At least one phone or one email required. Zero phone and zero email not allowed.
- Duplicate Contact Detection and Merge (3.2.1.1.3): Detect potential duplicates when new/imported contact matches existing by exact name (case-insensitive), phone number, or email. Show side-by-side comparison. Provide options: Keep Both, Merge, Replace. Merge preserves both conflicting phone/email values; for conflicting name/company, prefer new data. (TODO: fuzzy matching threshold pending UX research Q3 2026)
- Contact Search and Filtering (3.2.1.2.1): Real-time search as user types; partial substring match across name, phone, email. Retain last 10 search queries. Filter by group (Family, Work, Friends), favorite status, and recently added (within 7 days).
- Cloud Synchronization (3.2.1.3.1): When user signed in and internet active, automatically sync on app launch and on create/update/delete of contacts.
- Data Export (3.2.1.3.2): Export contact list in VCF (vCard), CSV, and JSON. Include all populated fields: name, phones, emails, company, job title, notes, custom fields, and photo (embedded in VCF, as file reference in CSV/JSON).
- Localization - General (3.2.1.4.1): App activates only if device locale and SIM MCC correspond to a supported country. Apply country-specific phone number formatting based on detected country code.
- Localization - iOS (3.2.1.4.2): For iOS, activation uses Apple ID region code to verify supported country. Phone number formatting based on user's region at activation.

Non-functional requirements summary:
- Supported Device - Android (3.2.2.1.1): App must be searchable/downloadable only on Google Play Store for Android 10 (API level 29) or above. Not exposed to Android 9 or lower.
- Supported Device - iOS (3.2.2.1.2): App must be searchable/downloadable on Apple App Store for iOS 15.0 or above. Not exposed to lower versions.

Validation and constraints:
- Input validation rules per Field Validation (name length, phone format, email format, at least one contact method).
- Duplicate detection triggers on exact name, phone, or email; actions must be clearly presented.
- Search must update in real time and support partial matches; history limited to last 10 queries.
- Sync requires signed-in user and active internet; automatic trigger events defined.
- Export must support three formats with specific field inclusion and photo handling.
- Geographic restriction: device locale/SIM MCC (Android) and Apple ID region (iOS) must be in supported country list; activation and phone formatting depend on this.
- Platform OS minimums: Android 10 (API 29) and iOS 15.0.

Coverage priorities for next tests:
- Test Add New Contact validations: boundary values (name 100/101, phone formats, email invalid), missing both phone and email, persistence after confirmation.
- Duplicate detection scenarios: exact name match case-insensitivity, phone match, email match, and merge/keep/replace options; verify merge conflict resolution.
- Search functionality: real-time updates, partial substring across all fields, filter combinations (group, favorite, recently added), search history persistence and limit (10 queries).
- Cloud sync: trigger on launch and CRUD, offline behavior and error handling, data consistency across devices.
- Export: generate VCF/CSV/JSON with all field types including photo references/embedded; verify format validity and data completeness.
- Localization/region enforcement: test with unsupported locale/SIM/Apple ID region to confirm app blocked; test phone number formatting per country.
- Platform compatibility: verify app not visible or installable on Android 9/iOS 14, and functional on minimum supported versions.

properties.srs_summary:
Document: Software Requirements Specification — ShobarKhamar Android Application
Functional requirements summary:
- Authentication [FR-AUTH]: Session persistence assumed; registration, OTP, password recovery, and account deletion are PRECONDITION-SATISFIED and out of scope.
- Navigation & Discovery [FR-NAV]: Splash screen, primary nav (Home, Blog, Order, Search, Menu), home entry points, free-text search, detail views, pagination/lazy loading, loading/empty/failure states, location selector.
- Marketplace Browsing [FR-PROD]: Browse cattle, feed, medicine, equipment by role; product details (price, desc, seller); share functionality; filters (category, type, breed, price, location); unavailable product handling.
- Favourites [FR-FAV]: Add/remove products, list view, visual acknowledgement, state persistence across navigation.
- Orders [FR-ORD]: Buyer initiation/form/submission/list/detail/status view; Seller incoming list/detail/status update; Equivalent workflows for Feed/Medicine/Machinery sellers; Empty/error/duplicate prevention states.
- Farm & Animal Management [FR-FARM, FR-ANM]: Seller farm registration (name, type, location, validation), updates with feedback; Multi-step animal record addition (type/breed/attributes) with abandonment safety.
- Seller Publishing [FR-SELL]: Publish/edit cattle listings (price, attrs, images from gallery/camera); Store registration and publishing for Feed, Medicine, Machinery; Availability status changes; Input validation; Role-based visibility isolation (no cross-role access).
- Reviews [FR-REV]: View seller reviews/ratings; Submit review post-interaction; Validation; Success acknowledgment; Pagination; Empty state handling.
- Chat [FR-CHT]: Inbox listing, message history, send message, immediate appearance, empty inbox state.
- Notifications [FR-NOT]: List view, unread count, mark as read/update count, empty state, deep link support.
- Location [FR-LOC]: Permission requests, nearby ranking, map selection, graceful degradation on denial, duplicate request prevention, region change impact.
- Disease & Health Check [FR-DIS]: Browse disease list/details; AI health check via image upload; Result presentation with limitations; Error handling for inference failures.
- Profile & Settings [FR-PROF, FR-SET]: View/edit/persist profile fields; Shareable profile links; Role-specific settings; Sign-out defined but excluded from testing to preserve session.

Non-functional requirements summary:
- NFR-01: Primary screens interactive without unreasonable delay on stable network.
- NFR-02: Long lists must use pagination rather than unbounded loading.
- NFR-03: Network, image, and inference operations must be non-blocking.
- NFR-04: Backend failures must be explicitly reported to the user.
- NFR-05: Interface remains usable during offline or slow network conditions.
- NFR-06: Destructive or irreversible actions require explicit confirmation dialogs.

Validation and constraints:
- Pre-provisioned authenticated session is active; do not test login, registration, OTP, password changes, or logout.
- Test images are pre-seeded in device gallery; select existing images for FR-SELL-01, FR-SELL-14, and FR-DIS-03 flows.
- Seller roles are already approved; focus on data management and order processing within those roles.
- Ensure no accidental creation of duplicate orders (FR-ORD-12) or partial animal records (FR-ANM-04).
- Verify strict role isolation: sellers cannot access other roles' publishing/order screens (FR-SELL-13).

Coverage priorities for next tests:
- High: End-to-end Order lifecycle (Buyer submit -> Seller update -> Buyer view) including error/duplicate handling.
- High: Seller Publishing workflows for all four categories (Cattle, Feed, Medicine, Machinery) focusing on validation and image attachment.
- High: AI Health Check flow (FR-DIS-03/04/05) verifying image upload, result clarity, and failure states.
- Medium: Favourites persistence and state accuracy across navigation.
- Medium: Location permission denial handling and its effect on discovery ranking vs usability.
- Medium: Review submission validation and immediate UI reflection.
- Low: Notification marking/deep-linking and Chat basic send/receive mechanics.

3.2 Phone Software Requirements
-- 
3.2.1 Functional Requirements
-- 
3.2.1.1 Contact Management
-- 
3.2.1.1.1 Add New Contact
DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The phone application shall provide an interface to allow the user to add a new contact by entering the contact's name, phone number, email address, and optional fields such as company, job title, and notes. The application shall save the contact to the local database immediately upon user confirmation. 

RATIONALE/ JUSTIFICATION OF THE REQUIREMENT: The primary function of the Contacts+ application is to allow users to create and store contact information. The data shall be persisted immediately to prevent data loss.
3.2.1.1.2 Contact Field Validation
DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The phone application shall validate the contact fields before saving a contact according to the following rules:
•	Name field shall not be empty and shall not exceed 100 characters.
•	Phone number field shall conform to the following formats:
o	International format starting with '+' followed by country code and subscriber number (e.g., +1-555-0123)
o	National format with area code and subscriber number (e.g., 555-0123)
•	Email address field, if provided, shall conform to standard email format (local-part@domain).
•	The application shall not allow saving a contact with zero phone numbers and zero email addresses.
o	At least one phone number or one email address shall be provided.

RATIONALE/ JUSTIFICATION OF THE REQUIREMENT: Invalid contact data can cause issues when the user attempts to call, message, or email a contact. Field validation ensures data integrity and a consistent user experience.
3.2.1.1.3 Duplicate Contact Detection and Merge
DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The phone application shall detect and notify the user when a newly added or imported contact is a potential duplicate of an existing contact. A potential duplicate is identified when:
1.	The contact name matches exactly (case-insensitive) with an existing contact, or
2.	The phone number matches an existing contact's phone number, or
3.	The email address matches an existing contact's email address.

When a potential duplicate is detected, the phone application shall display both the existing and new contact information side by side and provide the following options:
- Keep Both : saves the new contact as a separate entry
- Merge : combines the fields of both contacts into a single entry, preserving all unique field values
- Replace : overwrites the existing contact with the new contact data

The merge operation shall resolve field conflicts using the following priority:
- For conflicting phone numbers or email addresses: retain both values as separate entries within the same contact
- For conflicting name or company: prefer the newly entered data

(TODO: The duplicate detection threshold and fuzzy matching sensitivity will be defined after UX research is completed in Q3 2026)

RATIONALE/ JUSTIFICATION OF THE REQUIREMENT: Duplicate contacts create confusion when searching or communicating. Automatic detection and guided merge helps the user maintain a clean and organized contact list without manual effort.
3.2.1.2 Search and Filtering
-- 
3.2.1.2.1 Contact Search and Filtering
DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The phone application shall provide a search function that allows the user to find contacts by name, phone number, or email address. The search shall support the following behaviors:
1.	Real-time search: results shall update as the user types each character in the search field.
2.	Partial match: the search shall match contacts that contain the search query as a substring in any searchable field.
3.	Search history: the application shall retain the last 10 search queries for quick re-access.

Additionally, the phone application shall provide filtering options to narrow down the contact list by:
•	Contact group (e.g., Family, Work, Friends)
•	Favorite status
•	Recently added (within the last 7 days)

RATIONALE/ JUSTIFICATION OF THE REQUIREMENT: Users with large contact lists need an efficient way to find specific contacts. Real-time search and filtering significantly reduce the time and effort required to locate a contact.
3.2.1.3 Data Sync and Backup
-- 
3.2.1.3.1 Cloud Synchronization
DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The phone application shall synchronize the contact data with the user's cloud account when the user is signed in and has an active internet connection. The synchronization shall be performed automatically when the application is launched or when a contact is created, updated, or deleted. 

RATIONALE/ JUSTIFICATION OF THE REQUIREMENT: Cloud synchronization ensures that the user's contact data is available across multiple devices and is not lost if the user's phone is lost, damaged, or replaced.
3.2.1.3.2 Data Export
DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The phone application shall allow the user to export their contact list in the following formats:
- VCF (vCard) : standard format compatible with most contact applications
- CSV : comma-separated values format for spreadsheet import
- JSON : structured data format for programmatic access

The exported file shall include all contact fields that have data:
•	Name, phone numbers, email addresses
•	Company, job title
•	Notes and custom fields
•	Contact photo (embedded in VCF, as file reference in CSV and JSON)

RATIONALE/ JUSTIFICATION OF THE REQUIREMENT: Users shall be able to export their contact data for backup purposes or for migration to another application or service.
3.2.1.4 Localization
-- 
3.2.1.4.1 Supporting regions and countries
DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The phone application shall be activated only if a user is within a supported country. The phone device country code shall be checked with the device locale settings and the user's region shall be verified through the SIM card's MCC (Mobile Country Code). 
1.	At the time of initial activation, the phone application shall check whether the device locale and SIM MCC correspond to a supported country.
2.	In the case of phone number formatting dependent on each country, the phone application shall apply the appropriate format based on the detected country code.

RATIONALE/ JUSTIFICATION OF THE REQUIREMENT: The Contacts+ application may have region-specific regulatory requirements for data storage and privacy. This limitation shall be enforced using the device locale and SIM MCC.
3.2.1.4.2 Supporting regions and countries - iOS
The phone application shall be activated only if a user is within a supported country while using the phone with the approved region setting. The user's Apple ID region code will be used to identify the user's country. 
In the case of phone number formatting dependent on each country, the phone application provides them according to the user's region at the time of activation. 

RATIONALE/ JUSTIFICATION OF THE REQUIREMENT: The Contacts+ application may have region-specific regulatory requirements for data storage and privacy. This limitation shall be provided using the Apple ID region of the user.
3.2.2 Non-Functional Requirements
-- 
3.2.2.1 Constraint
-- 
3.2.2.1.1 Supported Device
DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The phone application shall be searched and downloaded from the Google Play Store only on Android devices with Android 10 (API level 29) or above OS version. 

RATIONALE/ JUSTIFICATION OF THE REQUIREMENT: The phone application should not be exposed to the Android 9 (API level 28) or lower OS version devices at the Google Play Store.
3.2.2.1.2 Supported Device - iOS
DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The phone application shall be searched and downloaded from the Apple App Store on devices with iOS 15.0 or above OS version. 

RATIONALE/ JUSTIFICATION OF THE REQUIREMENT: The phone application should not be exposed to the lower than iOS 15.0 devices at the Apple App Store.

Software Requirements Specification — ShobarKhamar Android Application
Package: com.tirzokpvt.shobarkhamar   Framework: Flutter   Build under test: 2.1.3

ShobarKhamar is a livestock and agricultural marketplace connecting farmers, buyers,
cattle sellers, feed sellers and supporting services. Users discover cattle, feed,
medicine and equipment; sellers publish listings and manage incoming order requests;
buyers favourite products, request orders, review sellers and chat with them. The app
also provides livestock disease information with AI-assisted health checking, and uses
device location to rank nearby farms and products.

SCOPE NOTE FOR THIS TEST CAMPAIGN
The device is signed in with a pre-provisioned account before the campaign starts.
Sections marked PRECONDITION-SATISFIED below describe behaviour that is already in
place and MUST NOT be re-tested: completing them requires an SMS one-time password
delivered to a phone we do not control, a national identity document, platform admin
approval, or a phone number that is consumed permanently on first use. They are listed
so their outcomes can be relied upon, not so they can be exercised. Every other section
is in scope.
